name: Briefings
description: Keeps each person's briefing definitions and past runs, private to the owner. A definition can be shared. Saving a definition sets or removes its scheduled run in the person's time zone, and the list moves run times after a time zone change. Writing a briefing, the run job, the screens and outside sources are not part of this package yet.

settings.label: Briefings
settings.description: Briefing times and sources can be changed through the Briefings routes. The Settings page for them is not part of this package yet.

features.description: Each person keeps private briefing definitions for the morning briefing, the evening review and the weekly review. A definition holds a title, how often it runs, the time of day in the person's time zone, a switch and the read tools it may use. Saving a definition sets or removes its scheduled run. A person it is shared with can see it, and can change it only with manage access; only the owner's changes move the owner's schedule.

Briefings run at the person's set time in their saved time zone. After a time zone change, the next visit to the definitions list moves the run times. The run itself and the written briefing are not part of this package yet.

List past briefing runs newest first, or read one run by id. Earlier reports stay dated and read-only. A run written without AI returns empty summary text, so its source list is never shown. Only the owner sees runs, even for a definition shared with someone else.

errors.description: The named briefing run is missing or owned by someone else; both cases look the same so runs cannot be probed.

remediations.description: Pick the newest run in the briefing history and read it instead.
